name: design-system
description: Design-system-agnostic component skills (Button, Input, Card, Dialog, Table, Form, Badge, Select, Tabs, Toast). Each skill detects whatever design system a project already runs — a branded shadcn registry (Fission's or another client's own), bare shadcn, MUI, Chakra, AntD, or plain CSS — and adapts instead of assuming one stack. Carries zero Fission-specific logic itself; Fission's own registry is one registered entry in shared/references/brand-registries.json, same shape any other client's private registry would use.
_schema_note: Verified against https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference (checked 2026-10-09). The 'skills' array is intentionally omitted: it only adds to the default skills/ scan and every skill here already lives under skills/, so listing it was a redundant hand-maintained duplicate. 'owners' moved under 'metadata' — it isn't a recognized top-level field and would otherwise be silently stripped with a validate warning; 'metadata' is the documented place for free-form data Claude Code doesn't read.
